Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A dairy customer whose daily milk deliveries and payments are tracked.

phone.description: Optional customer phone number (up to 20 characters).

address.description: Optional street or locality address (up to 120 characters).

milkType.description: Default milk type supplied to the customer.

defaultQtyLiters.description: Default daily milk quantity in liters (0 to 1000).

ratePerLiter.description: Default rate per liter in INR (1 to 1000).

openingBalance.description: Opening due (+) or advance (-) balance in INR.

active.description: Whether the customer currently receives active deliveries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

MilkEntry.title: MilkEntry
MilkEntry.description: A daily milk delivery record for a customer in a specific shift.

customerId.description: Document ID of the customer under the same user.

customerName.description: Denormalized customer display name (1 to 80 characters).

ratePerLiter.description: Rate per liter in INR (0 to 1000).

totalAmount.description: Computed total cost in INR (0 to 1000000).

absent.description: True when customer skipped delivery on this date/shift.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A payment collected from a customer against their milk ledger.

customerId.description: Document ID of the customer under the same user.

customerName.description: Denormalized customer display name (1 to 80 characters).

amount.description: Amount received in INR (> 0 up to 1000000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Owner-scoped collection of dairy customers and their default delivery rates.

/users/{userId}/milk_entries/{entryId}.description: Owner-scoped collection of daily milk delivery records.
